source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"The anesthesia plan, including its specific risks, benefits, and alternatives, distinct from surgical consent","B":"Consent covering mainly the surgical procedure itself rather than the anesthesia plan specifically","C":"Fairly little separate consent at all, since anesthesia is often assumed to be covered by the surgical consent alone","D":"Consent focused mainly on billing and financial arrangements for the anesthesia service"}}
source_row.rationale: Anesthesia providers typically obtain separate informed consent specifically addressing the anesthesia plan, its risks, benefits, and alternatives, distinct from (though related to) the surgical procedure consent.
